name: Back to back
description: Black has rolled 5 (infantry) and 3 (heavy). Every piece that moves forward only may swap with another back to back, whatever their kinds: Black's Makruk Pawn on d3 with Green's Western Pawn on d4 (the 5), and Black's Shogi Lance on f3 with Green's Shogi Pawn on f4 (the 3).
